prompt: How do I number pages starting from the second page in Word?
completion:
To number pages starting from the second page in Microsoft Word, follow these steps:

1. **Insert a Section Break**:
   - Place your cursor at the end of the first page.
   - Go to the **Layout** or **Page Layout** tab (depending on your version of Word).
   - Click on **Breaks** > **Next Page** under the **Section Breaks** section. This will insert a section break and start a new section on the second page.

2. **Insert Page Numbers**:
   - Go to the **Insert** tab.
   - Click on **Page Number** and choose the location where you want the page numbers to appear (e.g., top, bottom, inside, outside).
   - Select a page number style.

3. **Format Page Numbers**:
   - With the page numbers still selected, go to the **Page Number** group in the **Insert** tab.
   - Click on **Format Page Numbers**.
   - In the **Page Number Format** dialog box, select **Start at** and enter **2**.
   - Click **OK**.

4. **Link to Previous (Optional)**:
   - If you want to ensure that the page numbering continues correctly, go to the **Layout** or **Page Layout** tab.
   - Click on **Breaks** > **Next Page** to insert another section break at the end of the second page.
   - Double-click the header or footer of the second page to open the Header & Footer Tools.
   - Click on **Link to Previous** to unlink the header/footer from the first page.

This will start your page numbering from the second page onwards.
